entities.name: Ahmad Yani
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Ahmad Yani was the Minister/Commander of the Army, a position equivalent to the modern Chief of Staff of Indonesian Army. who was killed by members of the 30 September Movement during an attempt to kidnap him from his house.
